verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a Records API for retrieving and updating contract records, an outbound webhooks service with full create/list/update/delete management, and a Workflows API to launch workflows. An agent could plausibly read contract data, react to events, and kick off follow-up workflows. However, none of the evidence mentions renewal dates, expiration or deadline fields, or renewal/obligation events. Monitoring renewals specifically is therefore only implied by generic record access, and API access requires a paid add-on. Missing for 10: documented renewal/expiration date fields or deadline-reminder events in the API, an example of acting on upcoming renewals (e.g., launching a renewal workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
